Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

What you'll be doing

Responsibilities of this position are to assist the Heart Failure - Transplant Cardiologist in the pre and post-Transplant assessment and care of patients with severe heart failure, pulmonary hypertension, advanced heart disease, temporary and durable mechanical circulatory support and cardiac transplantation. 
 
The preferred candidate for the Fellowship will have completed Cardiology Advanced Training and have experience in diagnostic cardiac catheterisation, echocardiography, intra-aortic balloon pump insertion, right heart catheterisation and some experience in endomyocardial biopsy.

St Vincent's Health Network Sydney (SVHN) forms part of the NSW region of St Vincent's Health Australia which is the largest diversified health care organisation within Australia's not for profit and Catholic health care sectors. SVHN comprises some of Australia's oldest and most prestigious hospitals; these include St Vincent's Hospital and Sacred Heart Hospice. Along with three co-located research institutes - the Victor Chang Cardiac Research Institute, the Garvan Institute of Medical Research, and St Vincent's Institute of Medical Research - we work in close partnership with other research bodies, universities, and health care providers.

Centrally located in Darlinghurst, it sits on the edge of Sydney's business district. St Vincent's follows the philosophy of the Mary Aikenhead Ministries in its service to all regardless of race, nationality or creed. St Vincent's Health Australia provides compassionate healthcare to people from all walks of life, but reflecting our mission, we are especially committed to people from vulnerable and marginalised backgrounds.

The Hospital has a long-standing reputation for treating the highest acuity and complex patient loads, attracting referrals on a state-wide and national basis. The Hospital is a teaching hospital of the UNSW and University of Notre Dame and has academic associations with the Australian Catholic University, Sydney University and the University of Technology, Sydney.

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!

skillset for the management of patients in the acute inpatient and GP setting.

This Child and Maternal Health SRMO program would suit trainees considering a career in rural general practice as a
Rural Generalist, or in the specialties of Paediatrics, and Obstetrics-Gynaecology. Trainees will be given responsibilities
and opportunities for autonomous practice commensurate with their experience. This will be accompanied by appropriate
supervision, training and support to enable development of relevant skills during the training year.

Our program begins with a comprehensive orientation designed to familiarise you with our hospital's operations, culture,
and will ensure a baseline level of competency at core skills required for the position. You will benefit from the weekly
training program during the year, which will include hands-on clinical experiences, simulation-based education, interactive
workshops, and integration into our multidisciplinary teams. The teaching program will be complemented by ongoing
mentorship from experienced senior medical staff, ensuring you receive personalised guidance and support.
Accommodation is provided for the full 12 months of the program and there is a small travel allowance available.

The Rural Child and Maternal Health SRMOs work and learn alongside our Rural Critical Care SRMOs in a single

This is a Category 'A' position, please read and understand NSW Health policy directive PD2024_015. All new
employees must agree to comply with the requirements outlined in this policy. OASV requirements also include proof of
vaccination against influenza and is compulsory for NSW Staff that enter any Residential Aged Care Facility (RACF) or
who work in NSW Health owned and operated RACFs.

With 348 treatment spaces, we are the major Rural Referral Hospital to the North West of NSW. We conduct over 9000 surgical procedures per annum over 5 theatre spaces; with the new facility boasting an additional 3 theatre rooms which have been built for future growth.
